ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As the figure shows, the line $y=kx-\frac{3}{2}$ intersects with $y=mx-5$ at point $A\left(1, -3\right)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx-\frac{3}{2}>mx-5$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} By observing the graph, we know that when $x=1$, $kx-\frac{3}{2}=mx-5$.\\
Therefore, when $x<1$, $kx-\frac{3}{2}>mx-5$.\\
Thus, the answer is $\boxed{x<1}$.
